CreateAProxyInstance.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string of no more than 64 characters.
CreateAProxyInstance.billing: Billing-related parameters. Proxy instances only support Postpaid billing. [Refer to structure and values](/doc/RDS/s/9jwvz0wd3#billing)
CreateAProxyInstance.billing.paymentTiming: Payment method (Postpaid; read-only instances only support Postpaid).
CreateAProxyInstance.instanceName: User-defined instance name. Requirements: 1) only lowercase letters and digits are allowed; 2) length must be 1 to 32 characters. Defaults to rdsproxy.
CreateAProxyInstance.nodeAmount: Number of proxy instance nodes. Valid values: 2, 4, 6, 8, 16.
CreateAProxyInstance.zoneNames: Specifies zone information. Empty by default, in which case the system selects automatically. You can query the available zone list via the [Query Available Zone List](/doc/RDS/s/zka65zqz2) API. The zoneName naming convention is lowercase "country-region-zone sequence", for example Beijing Zone A is "cn-bj-a". It is recommended to keep it consistent with the master instance's zone.
CreateAProxyInstance.vpcId: Same as the master instance's vpcId.
CreateAProxyInstance.isDirectPay: Whether to pay directly. Defaults to false. Orders set to direct payment are charged immediately without going through the payment process.
CreateAProxyInstance.subnets: The subnetId of the zone within a specific VPC. If the specified vpcId is a custom VPC, subnetId must be specified. You can query the subnet list via the [Query Subnet List](/doc/RDS/s/Wka66184u) API. It is recommended to keep it consistent with the master instance's subnet.
CreateAProxyInstance.ovip: The ovip of the BLB used as the RDS instance access entry. If this parameter is passed with a non-empty value, the BLB is applied for using this value as the BLB's ovip; otherwise, the BLB is assigned a random IP.
CreateAProxyInstance.entryPort: The port of the BLB used as the RDS instance access entry. If this parameter is passed with a non-empty value, the BLB is applied for using this value as the BLB's listener port; otherwise, it defaults to 3306. Valid port range: 1024-65535.
CreateAProxyInstance.resourceGroupId: Resource group ID, for example: RESG-bKMxbExtnoG.
